name: Republic of the Rif
alt: Confederal Republic of the Tribes of the Rif

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Spain
predecessors.text: the Rif of the Spanish protectorate, where the Rifians captured over 130 Spanish military posts and proclaimed the Republic of the Rif in September 1921

successors.name: Kingdom of Spain
successors.text: the Rif, conquered by Spanish and French forces; the infobox names the Spanish protectorate in Morocco as successor

ledger.x: 1921: the Rifians proclaim the Republic of the Rif on 18 September.
1921: the Rif War front with Spanish Morocco.
1924: Spain pulls back from Chefchaouen and Oued Laou.
1925: the Rifians attack the French line on 12 April.
1925: Spain secures Alhucemas Bay in September.
1926: the Rif front closes with the surrender of 27 May 1926.
1926: the Republic of the Rif ends on 27 May.

wars.name: Rif War
wars.outcome: Spanish-French victory and the Spanish conquest of the Rif; Abd el-Krim surrendered on 27 May 1926 (infobox: war ended June 1926).

certainty.note: The Rif's frontiers were the lines of a war and of tribal allegiance; the page gives no boundaries or area.
